items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions, with active mass exploitation observed recently via malicious file uploads.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (includes BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849 (named BlockStrap by Sansec), a critical template engine injection flaw (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Patches Magento Zero-Day Exploited to Deploy Rust Backdoor and PHP Web Shell (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, codenamed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated remote code execution through PHP code injection in Magento's template system and has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction and has been actively exploited.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (includes RCE via unrestricted file upload)
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48356, a remote code execution flaw caused by unrestricted upload of files with dangerous types.
